search_box.name: Search Input
search_box.selector: input[name='q'], input[title='Search for products, brands and more'], input[placeholder='Search for products, brands and more']
search_box.xpath: //input[@type='text' and (contains(@placeholder, 'Search for products') or @title='Search for products, brands and more')]
search_box.description: The main text field at the top of the Flipkart homepage where users type product queries.

search_button.name: Search Button
search_button.description: Button that triggers the product search after a query is entered in the search box.

cart_button.name: Cart Icon/Button
cart_button.description: Link or button that opens the user's shopping cart, usually displayed as a bag icon in the header.

sign_in_button.name: Sign‑In Button
sign_in_button.description: Button that opens the login modal for existing users.

account_button.name: Account Dropdown
account_button.description: User avatar or name element that expands to show account options after a successful login.

deals_link.name: Deals / Offers Link
deals_link.description: Navigation link that directs users to the daily deals or offers page.

navigation_menu.name: Top Navigation Menu
navigation_menu.description: Container holding the primary category links (e.g., Electronics, Fashion, Home) displayed horizontally at the top of the page.

product_links.name: Product Tile Links
product_links.description: Links wrapping each product card on the homepage or category pages, leading to the product detail page.
